description: This Java source file defines a final class 'ThingsPersistenceStreamingActorCreator' that creates and manages Akka actors for streaming persisted 'things' data, including methods to start event and snapshot streaming actors, and utility methods for converting between entity IDs and persistence IDs.

classes.name: ThingsPersistenceStreamingActorCreator
classes.description: A utility class that creates and manages Akka actors for streaming persisted 'things' data, including methods to start event and snapshot streaming actors, and internal conversion utilities.

methods.name: startEventStreamingActor
methods.description: Creates and starts an actor for streaming from the event journal, using a provided actor creation function.

methods.name: startSnapshotStreamingActor
methods.description: Creates and starts an actor that streams from the snapshot store, using a provided actor creation function.

methods.name: createElement
methods.description: Creates a 'ThingTag' object from a 'PidWithSeqNr' object, associating a persistence ID with a sequence number.

methods.name: createPidWithSeqNr
methods.description: Creates a 'PidWithSeqNr' object from an 'EntityIdWithRevision', converting an entity ID to a persistence ID and including revision.

methods.name: pid2EntityId
methods.description: Converts a persistence ID string to a 'ThingId' by removing a prefix pattern.

methods.name: entityId2Pid
methods.description: Converts an 'EntityId' to a persistence ID string by prepending a prefix.
